vuln_statements.explanation: This is the ulpi_register function where the vulnerability exists. According to the root cause, this function fails to free the allocated ulpi structure when ulpi_of_register or ulpi_read_id fail. The function allocates the ulpi structure earlier (not shown in snippet) but lacks proper error handling cleanup code to kfree(ulpi) on failure paths, causing a memory leak.
